reviewIdentity: Distinct same-agent Codex evidence review; not an independent human review
limitations: All 240 answers per country are conservatively disclosed as educated assumptions, including institution-to-question interpretations.
Culture vs Nature, covert intelligence, hypothetical enhancement biotechnology and exact risk trade-offs have especially limited direct evidence.
Several axes retain more than four Neutral responses; separate reviews document the substantive competing policy elements for each.
Country cards currently render null classification labels in the existing shared UI. No classification or matching system was introduced by this contribution.

checks.browserInstallation: npx playwright install chromium webkit passed

endToEnd.reason: The same existing homepage-strip test failed in desktop, mobile and Safari: personality adolf-hitler is Unclassified while the test expects Far-Right. The ten country additions do not alter that profile or homepage classification logic.

archiveHistory.reason: 24 pre-existing modified ideology revision-1 archives differ from HEAD; all were already marked modified in starting-status.txt. They were preserved rather than overwritten or reverted.

checks.visualQA: All ten flags visually inspected in a contact sheet; representative desktop/mobile detail screenshots inspected, including settled India screenshots after animations and fonts completed.

sourceAccessNotes: Freedom House and constitutional text retrieved and read locally; IMF and additional primary/agency material read with the web tool.
State.gov investment-page attempts returned technical-difficulties content and are excluded from every assessment source list.
Some direct fetches returned HTTP 403 although web-tool indexed text was readable; citation titles disclose restricted excerpts where material was read only in search output.
Publication day was not invented when only month/year was supplied.
